register.perksBadge: Why Verified Sellers Partner With Us
register.perksDesc: Registered clients receive peace-of-mind safeguards, seasonal production priority, and personal engineer access.
register.perk1Desc: We strictly gate production behind your explicit digital sign-off. If the finished product deviates from your approved proof, we re-machine and re-dispatch at zero extra charge.
register.perk2Desc: Avoid peak-season manufacturing bottlenecks. Registered sellers receive reserved laser bed capacity and fast-tracked dispatch during Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and Prime Days.
register.perk3Desc: Skip generic help desk tickets. You are paired with a dedicated laser engineer and account manager reachable via WhatsApp, email, or telephone for agile changes.
register.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about setting up your account, integrating your Amazon storefront, and custom laser proofing.
register.faq1Q: Is there any setup fee or long-term commitment required to register?
register.faq1A: No. Account registration and initial intake consultations are 100% free of charge with zero setup fees. You only pay when you choose to activate a paid Amazon review quota plan or approve a physical laser engraving production run.
register.faq2Q: How does Printomation connect to my Amazon Seller Central account safely?
register.faq2A: We connect via Amazon's official Selling Partner API (SP-API) using OAuth 2.0 authorization. We never see or store your Seller Central master password. All communications are protected by 256-bit TLS encryption in strict adherence to Amazon's Data Protection Policy.
register.faq3Q: Can I register both for Amazon software automation and physical laser engraving?
register.faq3A: Yes! Our unified client platform allows you to manage automated customer review solicitation workflows while simultaneously placing and tracking bespoke physical laser engraving batches under one consolidated dashboard.
register.faq4Q: What vector formats should I submit for custom laser engraving?
register.faq4A: We recommend vector formats such as SVG, AI (Adobe Illustrator), EPS, and vector PDF for maximum edge sharpness. If you only possess high-resolution bitmap files (PNG, JPG), our in-house vector studio can digitize and optimize your artwork at no extra charge.
register.faq5Q: Can multi-brand aggregators register multiple seller storefronts?
register.faq5A: Yes. Our platform natively supports multi-brand management. You can connect and manage multiple Amazon marketplace storefronts (e.g. Amazon DE, FR, IT, ES, UK, US) within a single Printomation master account with separate billing and campaign permissions.
register.faq6Q: What if I need a physical sample before committing to a larger production run?
register.faq6A: You can easily request a physical prototype sample through your registered account dashboard. We will engrave your exact vector design on the target material and courier it to your address for final physical touch-and-feel verification.

contact.faq1Q: How fast do you respond to custom order inquiries?
contact.faq1A: Our studio desk typically responds within 2 business hours during working days, and always guarantees a reply within one business day.
contact.faq2Q: Can I request changes to my digital proof before engraving begins?
contact.faq2A: Yes! Production only commences after your explicit digital proof approval. We provide unlimited mockup iterations to ensure font kerning, graphic contrast, and cylinder placement are 100% satisfactory.
contact.faq3Q: Do you handle rush corporate orders and physical sample proofs?
contact.faq3A: Yes. For volume corporate gifting (50+ units), we can rush-produce and courier a physical sample piece within 48 hours for executive review before initiating the full production run.
contact.faq4Q: What file formats should I send with my message?
contact.faq4A: Vector files (SVG, AI, EPS, or vector PDF) produce the sharpest 1200 DPI laser results. High-resolution raster images (PNG, JPEG at 300+ DPI with solid contrast) are also fully supported.
contact.faq5Q: Where is your manufacturing facility located?
contact.faq5A: Our primary laser engraving and personalization studio is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with localized logistics lanes serving direct EU & UK fulfillment routes.

privacy.para1: Printomation ("we", "us", or "our") provides a B2B Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform for Amazon sellers. orderSync.bentoCap4Desc: Live tracking numbers, carrier labels, and fulfillment updates push back to Amazon & channels immediately upon ship.
orderSync.pipelineDesc: See how a sale becomes a proof, then a finished personalized product.
orderSync.step1Desc: Customer checks out on your storefront. Line items and shipping details sync to Printomation.
orderSync.step2Desc: Personalization fields and uploads bind to the order - or flag missing assets for your team.
orderSync.step3Desc: We verify SKU mapping, quantity limits, and content policy before sending a mockup.
orderSync.step4Desc: After proof approval, the job enters the craft schedule with estimated ship date.
orderSync.tableDesc: Inside your dashboard: incoming orders, proof status, production lane, and tracking - in one table.
orderSync.tableBullet1: Automatic timezone alignment on ship estimates
orderSync.tableBullet2: Instant hold on cancelled or disputed orders
orderSync.tableBullet3: One-click reopen proof for artwork fixes
orderSync.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about channel sync, artwork binding, and production holds.
orderSync.faqSupportDesc: Our team assists with storefront pipelines.
orderSync.faq1Q: How often does Printomation sync orders?
orderSync.faq1A: We use webhooks where available and high-frequency polling otherwise so your queue stays current within minutes.
orderSync.faq2Q: Does sync support both marketplace and direct stores?
orderSync.faq2A: Yes - connect the channels you sell on; all eligible custom SKUs land in the same studio hub.
orderSync.faq3Q: What happens if a buyer cancels after ordering?
orderSync.faq3A: Cancellation events suppress production and alert your team if a proof was already in progress.
orderSync.faq4Q: Can I exclude certain SKUs from auto-import?
orderSync.faq4A: Yes. Configure inclusion and exclusion rules so only personalized lines enter the craft queue.
orderSync.ctaHeading: Put custom order sync on autopilot
orderSync.ctaDesc: No CSVs, no lost personalization fields, no engraving before proof approval.

smartScheduling.heroDesc: Batch process hundreds of Amazon Custom orders into organized print and laser engraving files. Group by ASIN, material, or machine cell for maximum workshop efficiency.
smartScheduling.matrixDesc: Rushing engraving before proof approval wastes material; delaying shipment misses gifting moments. Smart scheduling balances both.
smartScheduling.quad1Desc: Production slots open only after digital approval - automatic holds if proof expires unapproved.
smartScheduling.quad2Desc: Proof emails and nudges timed for when your team actually reads inbox - not 3 AM server time.
smartScheduling.quad3Desc: Textiles, ceramic, and deep wood engrave get different default windows based on real studio throughput.
smartScheduling.quad4Desc: Customers see honest estimates that respect capacity - fewer angry "where is my gift?" messages.
smartScheduling.timelineDesc: How Printomation sequences proof, craft, and ship for personalized orders.
smartScheduling.phase0Desc: Checkout completes and personalization fields sync to the studio queue.
smartScheduling.phase1Desc: Digital mockup sent. Timer starts for your approval window.
smartScheduling.phase2Desc: Request tweaks without restarting the whole order - version history stays attached.
smartScheduling.phase3Desc: Laser, print, or stitch runs in a reserved slot with QC before pack-out.
smartScheduling.phase4Desc: Carrier pickup aligned to your quoted delivery date and region.
smartScheduling.calloutDesc: When proof approves or parcel ships, statuses flip in your dashboard and optional webhooks fire.
smartScheduling.faqDesc: Answers on proof windows, capacity, holidays, and delivery promises.
smartScheduling.faqSupportDesc: Our team assists with custom SLA rules.
smartScheduling.faq1A: Custom work needs an approved mockup. Starting early would risk wrong text placement, bad crops, or non-refundable material waste.
smartScheduling.faq2Q: Can I set different lead times per product?
smartScheduling.faq2A: Yes - configure defaults per product line or SKU so ship estimates match real craft duration.
smartScheduling.faq3Q: How do you handle holiday peaks?
smartScheduling.faq3A: Capacity rules tighten automatically and we surface honest cutoffs on checkout integrations where supported.
smartScheduling.faq4Q: Can the same order get double-produced?
smartScheduling.faq4A: No. Idempotent job IDs prevent duplicate engrave runs if a webhook retries.
smartScheduling.ctaDesc: Proof-first scheduling with studio-realistic ship dates.

reviewAnalytics.heroDesc: Monitor your daily automated file volume, generation latencies, error-prevention rates, and top-selling custom ASINs across all connected Amazon marketplaces.
reviewAnalytics.featureSectionHeading: Understand what drives your custom business
reviewAnalytics.featureSectionDesc: Go beyond order counts. Printomation shows which SKUs earn reorders, which channels spike seasonally, and where proof cycles slow you down.
reviewAnalytics.feat1Desc: See which product lines ship fastest and which attract the most revision rounds - fix templates before peak season.
reviewAnalytics.feat2Desc: Compare weekly production volume and SLA adherence across quarters.
reviewAnalytics.feat3Desc: Funnel analytics from order intake through proof, production, QC, and delivery.
reviewAnalytics.feat4Desc: Compare mix and margin-friendly volume across DTC, marketplace, and B2B sources.
reviewAnalytics.skuTableDesc: Track proof cycles, production time, and reorder rate per SKU in near real time.
reviewAnalytics.faqDesc: Everything you need to know about studio metrics, exports, and data privacy.
reviewAnalytics.faqSupportDesc: Our team assists with cohort exports.
reviewAnalytics.faq1Q: Does Printomation share my customer PII in analytics?
reviewAnalytics.faq1A: Reports focus on aggregate order and production metrics. Personal data stays scoped to fulfillment needs.
reviewAnalytics.faq2A: We compare promised ship dates to actual carrier handoffs per product line and channel.
reviewAnalytics.faq3Q: How can insights improve my catalog?
reviewAnalytics.faq3A: Spot SKUs with heavy revision loads - often a template or upload guideline issue - before you scale ads or gifting campaigns.
reviewAnalytics.faq4A: Yes. CSV and PDF exports are available from the dashboard for ops and finance teams.
reviewAnalytics.ctaDesc: See proof, production, and delivery data in one place - grow your custom brand with confidence.

vectorPreflight.heading: Automated inspection and file generation before production starts.
vectorPreflight.desc: Eliminate misprints, blurry buyer uploads, or incorrect layouts. Our automated pre-flight engine analyzes vector paths, validates image resolution, compensates for conical taper (for mugs and tumblers), and outputs precision files ready for your lasers and printers.
vectorPreflight.feature1Desc: Cleans up buyer graphics and outlines text fonts with 1200 DPI vector fidelity for crisp laser and print output.
vectorPreflight.feature2Desc: Automatically compensates for tumbler and mug tapers so engraved artwork wraps straight without distortion.
vectorPreflight.feature3Desc: Instantly flags low-DPI buyer uploads or unreadable text contrasts before your machines begin running.
